notes.title: Escape Until Friday v 1.0 released!
notes.content:
Finally, after over a year, Escape Until Friday is out of early access!
List of changes:

[b]List of changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Completely redesigned map
[*] Completed plot
[*] Cutscenes for each of the endings
[*] Updated user interface
[*] Improved AI
[*] Dark theme !!!
[*] New mechanics and more.
[/list]

notes.title: Escape Until Friday - Launch trailer
notes.content:
New Escape Until Friday trailer celebrating the game’s exit from Steam Early Access.

In the final version of the game you will find:
- Completely redesigned map
- Completed plot
- Cutscenes for each of the endings
- Updated user interface
- Improved AI
-Dark theme !!!
- New mechanics and more.

You can collect the story piece by piece and uncover the secrets of the maniac on October 1st.[previewyoutube=hrDkgAxlQmA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update v 0.15
notes.content:
Update v 0.15 is available!

[b]List of changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs with viewing through the walls
[*] Added support for QHD and 4K resolutions
[*] Fixed double spawn of key items
[*] Fixed a bug with death and missing items after killing a maniac
[/list]

notes.title: Escape until Friday is available now in Steam Early Access!
notes.content: Finally, Escape until Friday released in early access! This is just the beginning. Please share your opinion and propose new ideas in discussions to help us make the game better.
